note: Calibrated from a real Vital standalone GUI capture (Init Preset). Coords are in the reference_size pixel space; load_profile() scales them to the actual frame. Vital draws a WHITE pointer line over a teal fill-arc; pointer="white" reads the colourless pointer (bright + low-saturation) and ignores the arc, so absolute values are accurate (full SUSTAIN reads ~1.0). Extend by adding controls.

matrix._note: Calibrated from vital_matrix.png (Init Preset, MATRIX tab). Columns: # | SOURCE | BIPOLAR | STEREO | MORPH | AMOUNT | DESTINATION. The AMOUNT control is a horizontal bipolar slider whose CENTERED handle (value 0.5) means NO modulation; an init patch's one blank row (source/dest show '-') must read inactive -> read_matrix returns []. Coords are in reference_size space (2x the 1171x718 fixture); _load_matrix scales to the frame. Only the first (blank) row is calibratable from the empty fixture, but Vital matrix rows are uniform -- raise `rows` once a populated capture exists.

fx_list._note: EFFECTS page only. The effects RACK is the 2nd column (after MACRO 1-4); each row carries a coloured power dot at its top-left. Lit dots are purple/pink (S~100-120, V~255); off rows are grey (S<=44, V<=94). Calibrated from vital_effects.png (1171x718, exactly half this reference): dot column x=215, Chorus row y=85, pitch 58 -> doubled to reference space. Fixed top->bottom order is Vital's alphabetical rack.

_controls_note: OSC 1/2/3 LEVEL/PAN (+ OSC 1 unison/phase) calibrated from the Init Preset. OSC 2/3 are DIM (off on Init) but the white pointer is read skin-relative, so their LEVEL/PAN read correctly anyway (the coords are valid when a tutorial has them on). The reader records each knob's normalized POSITION [0,1] — the synth-specific position→display mapping (e.g. unison position 0.5 shows '20%') is non-linear, but recording position is reproduction-correct. Vital's filter CUTOFF/RESONANCE are GRAPH-DRAG controls (X/Y on the response graph), NOT knobs, so the white-pointer reader can't read them — those are graphic params for §8. The filter module's only knobs are DRIVE/MIX/KEY-TRK (dim/ambiguous unless the filter is enabled — deferred).
